description: This Python module implements a comprehensive subtitle correction pipeline. It includes text normalization, grammar and style corrections, OTT compliance adjustments, optional audio and transcript-aware corrections via ASR, and various helper functions to process subtitles and align them with transcripts or audio streams.

methods.name: bool _is_nan_value(value: Any)
methods.description: Checks if a value is NaN across types safely.

methods.name: str clean_text(value: Any)
methods.description: Converts input to a sanitized string, handling None, NaN, and numeric types gracefully.

methods.name: List[Dict] correct_subtitles_pipeline( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", enable_grammar: bool = True, enable_ott_rules: bool = True, enable_audio_correction: bool = False, audio_source: Optional[str] = None, asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, transcript: Optional[List[Dict]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the full subtitle correction process, including normalization, corrections, OTT compliance, and optional audio/transcript alignment.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace and punctuation spacing in subtitle text.

methods.name: None _apply_grammar_and_spell_corrections(cues: List[Dict], language: str = "en")
methods.description: Applies grammar, style, and spell corrections using language_tool_python if available.

methods.name: bool _is_change_reasonable(original: str, corrected: str)
methods.description: Evaluates whether a text change is acceptable based on fuzzy similarity ratios and heuristics.

methods.name: None _apply_ott_compliance_rules( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", max_lines_per_cue: int = 2, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, enforce_terminal_punctuation: bool = False, )
methods.description: Enforces OTT subtitle standards like line length, line count, terminal punctuation, and reading speed heuristics.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Greedy text wrapper to wrap text respecting max characters per line and max number of lines.

methods.name: str _adjust_for_reading_speed(text: str)
methods.description: Re-wraps or simplifies text based on reading speed heuristics when textstat is available.

methods.name: None _apply_transcript_timing_and_text_corrections( cues: List[Dict], transcript: List[Dict], *, timing_snap_threshold: float = 0.75, prefer_transcript_if_score_gap: int = 15, )
methods.description: Aligns subtitle cues with transcript segments, adjusting timings and text based on fuzzy matching and proximity.

methods.name: List[Dict] _normalize_transcript_segments(transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Normalizes various transcript input formats into a list of segments with start/end times and clean text.

methods.name: None _apply_audio_aware_corrections( cues: List[Dict], *, audio_source: Optional[str], language: str = "en", asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Uses ASR outputs to reconcile subtitle text with spoken audio, performing transcriptions if necessary.

methods.name: List[Dict] _run_asr( audio_source: str, *, language: str, model_name: Optional[str], device: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Attempts transcribing audio via faster-whisper or whisper backends if available.

methods.name: str _collect_asr_text_for_window(segments: List[Dict], start: float, end: float)
methods.description: Aggregates ASR transcriptions overlapping a specific subtitle time window.

methods.name: bool _overlaps(a_start: float, a_end: float, b_start: float, b_end: float)
methods.description: Checks whether two time intervals overlap.

methods.name: float _timestamp_to_seconds(ts: str)
methods.description: Converts timestamp string in HH:MM:SS,mmm format to seconds as float.

methods.name: str _harmonize_text_with_asr(sub_text: Any, asr_text: Any)
methods.description: Replaces tokens in subtitle text with closely matching ASR tokens for harmonization.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: Any)
methods.description: Splits text into words and punctuation tokens, preserving token boundaries.

methods.name: str _detokenize(tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Reconstructs text from token lists, respecting spacing and punctuation rules.

methods.name: str _match_casing(source: str, template: str)
methods.description: Matches the casing style of a source string to a template string.

methods.name: float _delta(a: float, b: float)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: int _fuzzy_ratio(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: float _plausibility_score(txt: str)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: str _seconds_to_timestamp(seconds: float)
methods.description: unavailable
